description: Full live check of one domain: RDAP registration (registrar, IANA id, created/updated/expiry, days to expiry, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC delegation), DNS + mail security audit (A/AAAA/NS/MX, SPF qualifier, DMARC policy, DKIM on 20 common selectors, CAA, DNSSEC DS) with a grade and issues list, the current TLS certificate (issuer, validity, SANs) and Certificate Transparency history from crt.sh. registration.domain_age_days = whole days since the registry creation date (RDAP, WHOIS fallback; null + domain_age_reason if unknown). Param domain. $0.01

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: domain_check
title: Domain check: RDAP, DNS + mail security, TLS, certificate history ($0.01)
